event.firm_key: WINDY ACRES CANDY & NUT OUTLET INC
event.recalling_firm: Windy Acres Candy & Nut, Outlet Inc.
event.distribution_pattern: The product was distributed only to two consignees in the state of Ohio.

products.product_description: RAW SUNFLOWER KERNEL, DARK RAISIN 50/50 MIX 24/l0 oz packaged in clear plastic wrap.
products.product_quantity: 7,968 units of 10 oz bags, 24 bags/case; 332 cases total
products.code_info: The affected product includes finished product lot number 0943, which was made using supplier lot number PRO-1349.
products.reason_for_recall: Windy Acres Candy and Nut recalled the affected product because they were informed by the supplier, Lipari Foods, that the sunflower seeds were potentially contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
